________________________________________
From: Duane Taylor <duanetaylor1941@gmail.com>
Sent: Friday, June 29, 2018 8:46 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Chris Bosio

Anthony I really don’t  know Chris and I am only writing to you because he sounds so sincere. He are a couple of more “nicknames” that people sometimes may name others without actually telling them. I told you about “Leaping Larry”. How about some one who talks a lot, I might refer to them as Chatty Cathy (without them knowing it), or how about Doubting Thomas (obviously plagiarized). People do have nicknames for others without them knowing about it. We need to know who the other person was.
Thank you,
Duane Taylor
